title: Creators’ App v3.5 Brings Creator-Made Creative Looks To Your Sony Camera
summary: Creators' App v3.5 lets compatible Sony cameras use Creative Looks customized by creators around the world, selected directly in the app.
body_markdown:
Every photographer develops a distinct visual language over time – through color, contrast, saturation, and the subtle choices that give an image its feel. With[Creators’ App version 3.5](https://creatorscloud.sony.net/catalog/en-us/creatorsapp/index.html#clbc) , Sony is making it easier to explore new creative directions before you press the shutter.


The latest update introduces Creative Look by creators, a new way to discover Creative Looks customized by creators around the world and add them directly to your compatible Sony camera. Rather than building every starting point from scratch, photographers can select a look in Creators’ App, transfer it to their camera, and begin shooting with that look immediately.


#### Meet Niah Aldrich And Her Portrait Pop Creative Look


Portrait photographer[Niah Aldrich](https://www.instagram.com/niahrosephoto/) knows that color, contrast, and mood are not finishing touches – they are central to the way an image tells its story. Her Creative Look, **Portrait Pop** , brings that sensibility into the camera, giving photographers a vibrant and polished starting point while they shoot.


##### Before Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


##### After Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


Designed to create bold, eye-catching portraits with rich contrast, crisp detail, and vibrant yet natural color, Portrait Pop balances protected highlights, open shadows, and subtle clarity. The result is added depth and dimension while authentic skin tones remain the focus – helping photographers create expressive, refined images straight out of camera.


##### Before Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


##### After Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


“I had so much fun creating this Creative Look!” Aldrich says. “It allows me to get closer to my final vision while I’m still shooting. I’m such a visual person, and color is a huge part of how I create, so being able to see that bold contrast, depth, and color pop right in camera helps me visualize where I’m going and make creative decisions in the moment.”


##### Before Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


##### After Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


“These images are straight out of camera, which really shows how much of the final look I’m able to create before I ever start editing,” Aldrich adds. “I hope you love this Portrait Pop as much as I do! I’m so excited that you’ll be able to apply my look directly to your own photos through[Sony’s Creators’ App](https://creatorscloud.sony.net/catalog/en-gb/creatorsapp/index.html) , alongside looks from some of your other favorite creators.”


##### Before Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


##### After Portrait Pop Creative Look


Photo by Niah Aldrich. Alpha 1 II. 50mm f/1.2 G Master.


#### How It Works


1. Connect your compatible Sony camera and smartphone in[Creators’ App](https://creatorscloud.sony.net/catalog/en-gb/creatorsapp/index.html) .
2. Explore **Creative Look by creators** in the app.
3. Select a creator-customized look and add it to your camera.
4. Start shooting with the look applied in camera.


As with other[Creators’ App](https://creatorscloud.sony.net/catalog/en-us/creatorsapp/index.html#clbc) functions, camera-smartphone connection and initial settings are required in advance. Some cameras also require the latest camera system software before the feature becomes available.


Explore the feature, available examples and compatible cameras in[Creators’ App](https://creatorscloud.sony.net/catalog/en-us/creatorsapp/index.html#clbc) .


See more of Niah Aldrich's work on Instagram[@niahrosephoto](https://www.instagram.com/niahrosephoto/) .
